description: This file defines the 'Row' class for the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a row in a worksheet with methods to access cell and column iterators, check if the row is empty, and retrieve its index and parent worksheet.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Represents a row within a Worksheet, providing access to its cells and metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Row instance with the specified worksheet and row index.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of this row.

methods.name: getCellIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the cells in this row, starting from a specified column.

methods.name: getColumnIterator
methods.description: Synonym for getCellIterator(), returns an iterator over columns in this row.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Determines whether the row is empty based on cell values and specific flags.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the parent worksheet of this row.
